name: COPM by Minteo
oneLiner: COPM is Minteo's Colombian peso stablecoin, backed by peso bank deposits and redeemable 1:1 by businesses that complete its compliance checks.
collateral: Colombian-peso bank deposits in accounts held in Minteo's name; the public reserve report does not name the banks or establish legal segregation.
pegMechanism: Businesses onboard through Minteo's manual AML/KYC review, then tokenize or redeem COPM 1:1 against Colombian pesos. Tax withholding and bank or network fees may apply. Public transparency terms do not establish a maximum fiat settlement time.

proofOfReserves.provider: BDO AUDIT S.A.S. BIC (ISAE 3000 limited assurance)

latestReport.reviewer: Pharos COPM addition review 2026-11-15: limited assurance over bank balances and Polygon, Celo and Solana token counts; October 19 is the BDO signature date
